integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone exact-rational checker; finite computation does not replace the all-N argument. Literature comparison leaves possible unindexed prior coverage.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-sample statement for the two specified positive two-harmonic densities. At N<=2 entire-curve laws agree; for N>=3 only the half-circle variance gap is asserted. No general identifiability, power analysis, or independently validated originality claim.
title: Three-point onset of Fourier-phase sensitivity in circular number variance
